description: Saves the footer every email carries, above the mailing address and unsubscribe link (those two are always added and cannot be changed here): up to 10 full-width link buttons (links, for example Shop men’s, Find your store), the "Follow us" social icon row (social handles plus social_icons: true), and a small disclaimer (pricing or legal note). Fields you leave out stay as they are; links: [] removes the buttons, disclaimer: "" removes the note. Applies to every email sent after saving, including scheduled ones that have not gone out yet. Uses no quota and sends nothing. Read brand_get first and only save what the person approved. Example: {"links": [{"label": "Shop men’s", "url": "https://shop.example/men"}, {"label": "Find your store", "url": "https://shop.example/stores"}], "social": {"instagram": "shopexample", "youtube": "shopexample"}, "social_icons": true, "disclaimer": "Prices may differ in stores."} Requires API key scope: draft.

disclaimer.description: Small print above the address, for example pricing, shipping or legal notes. **bold**, *italic* and [links](https://...) work. "" removes it.

links.description: Footer link buttons, top to bottom. Replaces the current list.

label.description: Button text, for example "Shop men’s" or "Find your store". Shown in capitals.

social.description: Social profiles: a handle ("shopexample", "@shopexample") or the profile link. "" removes one. These are the same profiles as Settings > Brand.

social_icons.description: true: show the profiles as a "Follow us" row of icons. false: plain text links (the older look).

name: brand_set_footer
title: Save email footer
